notes.title: One-Year Anniversary Update!!! V27 de 07/18/2025
notes.content:
[p]First of all, [b]Holy Heroes[/b] thanks everyone who believed in our gameplay!![/p][p]As part of the anniversary update, the game has undergone a restructuring. Starting with this version, you can now play in [b]Compact World Mode[/b], featuring smaller, more compact floors. This significantly speeds up level transitions and increases overall game dynamics.[/p][list][*][p]Doors: reduced from 40–50 to 20–20;[/p][/*][*][p]Connector Blocks: reduced from 40–50 to 12–15;[/p][/*][*][p]Special Zones: from 1–2 to 1;[/p][/*][*][p]Empty Zones: from 1–2 to 1;[/p][/*][*][p]Chests: +5 gold per chest, with additional bonuses based on floor level. Example: Floor 4 = 14 to 30 gold per chest;[/p][/*][*][p]Native starting monsters per floor: 30;[/p][/*][*][p]Guardian appears after 30 minutes;[/p][/*][*][p]Monster respawn: every 5 seconds;[/p][/*][*][p]Invasions: 1 in 600 chance;[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]• [b]Compact World[/b] will now be set as the [b]default world[/b]!

Enjoy the game, and we're always here for you![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111690/53ceb90195a3bcb0fd1386860dcb50b1ddea131e.jpg"][/img][/p]

tags.feature: Starting with this version, you can now play in [b]Compact World Mode[/b], featuring smaller, more compact floors. This significantly speeds up level transitions and increases overall game dynamics.

tags.balance_change: Doors: reduced from 40–50 to 20–20;
Connector Blocks: reduced from 40–50 to 12–15;
Special Zones: from 1–2 to 1;
Empty Zones: from 1–2 to 1;
Chests: +5 gold per chest, with additional bonuses based on floor level. Example: Floor 4 = 14 to 30 gold per chest;
Native starting monsters per floor: 30;
Guardian appears after 30 minutes;
Monster respawn: every 5 seconds;
Invasions: 1 in 600 chance;

tags.feature: [b]Compact World[/b] will now be set as the [b]default world[/b]!

notes.title: Update – v25 (February, 6, 2025)

notes.title: Achievements and Rankings
notes.content:
[b]Inclusion of Achievements (100) and Rankings (Leaderboard).[/b]
Be the winner of "[b]The Race for Achievements![/b]"
With a focus on rewarding existing Holy Heroes players while maintaining balance for newcomers, the leaderboard will consider some in-game progress. However, certain achievements (such as defeating Temporal Bosses, for example) will need to be faced again.
For the Race for Achievements Leaderboard, each unlocked achievement grants 1000 points, but 1 point is deducted for each hour of gameplay. In other words, the faster you complete the game, the better your ranking will be.
Key Details:
1.	Gameplay time for this leaderboard will be reset at launch.
2.	The demo version does not unlock achievements, but all progress is recorded. Most of it will count toward unlocking achievements and earning points in the leaderboard once the full game is purchased.
[b]Don’t waste any time—show off your skills now![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111690/2c533cee1f3650cae3136b72af142f5ce1eab0f1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update – V21.2 (November 19, 2024)
notes.content:
Temporal Bosses now provide 6 items as rewards: 1 Boss special; 2 Boss level items; 3 bags of gold.
- Precious gems included.
- Adjustment to the Berserk spell/skill: any monster killed will now provide +1 FOR, although the limit has been raised from +50 to +10 FOR, while maintaining the expiry time.
- Barbarian: the Courage skill will provide, in addition to courage, Hp regeneration, with 1 Hp every 5 to 10 seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111690/5b08b72367dfae09d4625072bacadc7aea013940.jpg[/img]
